entries.title: Matthew 17:1
segments: Six days later, Jesus took with him Peter, and the brothers James and John, and led them up a high mountain alone.

entries.title: Matthew 17:2
segments: There his appearance was transformed before their eyes; his face shown like the sun, and his clothes became as white as the light.

entries.title: Matthew 17:3
segments: And all at once Moses and Elijah appeared to them, talking with Jesus.

entries.title: Matthew 17:4
segments: "Master," exclaimed Peter, interposing, "it is good to be here; if you wish, I will make three tents here, one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah."

entries.title: Matthew 17:5
segments: While he was still speaking, a bright cloud enveloped them, and there was a voice from the cloud that said-- "This is my Son, the Beloved, in whom I delight; him you must hear."

entries.title: Matthew 17:6
segments: The disciples, on hearing this, fell on their faces, greatly afraid.

entries.title: Matthew 17:7
segments: But Jesus came and touched them, saying as he did so: "Rise up, and do not be afraid."

entries.title: Matthew 17:8
segments: When they raised their eyes, they saw no one but Jesus himself alone.

entries.title: Matthew 17:9
segments: As they were going down the mountain side, Jesus gave them this warning--"Do not speak of this vision to any one, until the Son of Man has risen from the dead."

entries.title: Matthew 17:10
segments: "How is it," his disciples asked, "that our Teachers of the Law say that Elijah has to come first?"

entries.title: Matthew 17:11
segments: "Elijah indeed does come," Jesus replied, "and will restore everything;

entries.title: Matthew 17:12
segments: And I tell you that Elijah has already come, and people have not recognized him, but have treated him just as they pleased. In the same way, too, the Son of Man is destined to undergo suffering at men's hands."

entries.title: Matthew 17:13
segments: Then the disciples understood that it was of John the Baptist that he had spoken to them.

entries.title: Matthew 17:14
segments: When they came to the crowd, a man came up to Jesus, and, kneeling down before him, said:

entries.title: Matthew 17:15
segments: "Master, take pity on my son, for he is epileptic and suffers terribly; indeed, he often falls into the fire and into the water;

entries.title: Matthew 17:16
segments: I brought him to your disciples, but they could not cure him."

entries.title: Matthew 17:17
segments: "O faithless and perverse generation!" Jesus exclaimed, "how long must I be among you? how long must I have patience with you? Bring the boy here to me."

entries.title: Matthew 17:18
segments: Then Jesus rebuked the demon, and it came out of the boy; and he was cured from that very hour.

entries.title: Matthew 17:19
segments: Afterwards the disciples came up to Jesus, and asked him privately: "Why was it that we could not drive it out?"

entries.title: Matthew 17:20
segments: "Because you have so little faith," he answered; "for, I tell you, if your faith were only like a mustard-seed, you could say to this mountain 'Move from this place to that!' and it would be moved; and nothing would be impossible to you."

entries.title: Matthew 17:21
segments: (Translation omits this verse.)

entries.title: Matthew 17:22
segments: While Jesus and his disciples were together in Galilee, he said to them: "The Son of Man is destined to be betrayed into the hands of his fellow-men,

entries.title: Matthew 17:23
segments: And they will put him to death, but on the third day he will rise." And the disciples were greatly distressed.

entries.title: Matthew 17:24
segments: After they had reached Capernaum, the collectors of the Temple-rate came up to Peter, and said: "Does not your Master pay the Temple-rate?"

entries.title: Matthew 17:25
segments: "Yes," answered Peter. But, on going into the house, before he could speak, Jesus said: "What do you think, Simon? From whom do earthly kings take taxes or tribute? From their sons, or from others?"

entries.title: Matthew 17:26
segments: "From others," answered Peter. "Well then," continued Jesus, "their sons go free.

entries.title: Matthew 17:27
segments: Still, that we may not shock them, go and throw a line into the Sea; take the first fish that rises, open its mouth, and you will find in it a piece of money. Take that, and give it to the collectors for both of us."
